seen_animation: A black line broom (long double-line handle, a fan of bristle strokes with one long curve sweeping to the right) stands in the left-center of the frame. In frames 1-3 its handle leans strongly from upper left down to the head, and a grey broom stands to its right. In frames 4-5 the black broom drops lower and further left (head partly cropped by the bottom edge in 5) while the grey broom rotates up and toward the upper right. In frame 6 the grey broom is only a few bristle lines at the top edge, and in frames 7-8 it is gone; the black broom is now nearly upright, center-left. In frames 9-11 the black broom leans again, slides right and lower, and a grey broom with a vertical handle reappears to its right. In frame 12 the black broom is low and further right, head cut off by the bottom edge. Frames 13-16 bring it back up and toward center-left, upright again, with the grey broom standing beside it on the right; in frame 16 the grey broom is drawn in broken, partial fragments.
seen_film: A real straw broom with a wooden handle leans in a dark room. Frames 1-3: the handle leans from upper left, head center-left, and a second broom appears at the right. Frames 4-5: the main broom moves down and left (head at the bottom edge) while the second broom swings up and toward the upper middle, as if lifted or flying. Frame 6: the second broom is at the top edge; the main broom stands nearly upright in center-left. Frames 7-8: the second broom has receded and gone; the main broom stands still. Frames 9-11: a narrow whisk broom stands to the right of the main broom, which leans and slides right and down. Frame 12: the main broom is low at the bottom right, head cut off. Frames 13-16: the main broom comes back up to center, upright, beside the whisk broom on the right.
named_subject: a straw broom (handle plus fanned bristles)
evidence: The black broom's head position tracks the film in every frame: center-left in 1-3, lower-left in 4-5 (cropped in 5 as in film frame 5), upright center-left in 6-8, sliding right and down in 9-11, low right and cropped in 12 (film frame 12 matches), returning upright in 13-16. The grey second broom rises to the upper right in 4-6 and is absent in 7-8, matching film frames 4-8, and stands to the right in 9-16 as the whisk broom does. The black drawing keeps c.png's construction in all 16 frames: double handle stroke with short inner line, peaked junction, loose fan of bristles, and the long right-hand curve. The only visible defect is frame 16, where the grey broom breaks into dashed fragments.
primary_gap: In frame 16 the grey scenery broom breaks into scattered fragments instead of staying a whole drawing, and in frames 9-16 it is drawn as a full-width broom rather than the narrow whisk broom of the film.
closes_when: Frame 16 shows the grey broom as complete continuous lines like frame 15, and the grey broom in frames 9-16 is drawn narrow (about half the main broom's width) to match the film's whisk broom.
protect: The black broom's frame-by-frame placement and lean that match the film (including the low cropped positions in frames 5 and 12), the faithful reproduction of c.png's stroke construction in every frame, and the timing of the second broom lifting away in 4-6 and being absent in 7-8.
identity_gap: None of consequence: the black broom is the c.png drawing with its handle tilted and its bristle fan kept stroke for stroke.
